description: A collection of associated assets to be delivered in response to calls for an image and corresponding metadata.

cid.description: The DRISL CID of the MASL for the image

createdAt.description: The timestamp that represents when the record was created.

nameKey.description: The primary human readable key for the record. It can be used to represent the file name. (File extensions should not be included. Types are provided by the contentType

pathKey.description: A optional, secondary human readable key. It can contain slashes and be used to represent a storage directory path.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp that represents the last time the record was update. Always availalbe. Matches createdAt when the image is first created.

extendedText.description: A second text field to match the format of the IPTC metadata setup.

language.description: The ISO 639 language code for the alt text.

text.description: The text content of the alt text.

contentType.description: The MIME content type for the payload

height.description: The height of the image payload in pixels

payload._TODO: Verify SVG isn't under 'image/*' and decided if it should be accepted or not

width.description: The width of the image payload in pixels

infoURL.description: The link to the place with more information about the copyright.

notice.description: The text to use when display the copyright

status.description: The copyright status of the asset
